status: Post-outcome context diagnostic. Claude's hand tallies and all earlier positional outcomes were read before selecting this audit.
freeze: This file was written before calculating the new outputs. It does not describe a preregistered test. The implementation refuses existing result files.

source.orientation: Use the supplied reading-order field without reversing it again. Check its relation to signs_visual_ltr and preserve the orientation_basis metadata. No new physical orientation adjudication is claimed.

shared_assumptions: The primary frame is distinct complete code strings; multiple occurrences of a code within one string remain distinct tokens. Face and object-family support are reported separately.

Exact preceding-two-sign contexts define descriptive formula clusters, with a START marker for missing predecessors. Their count is not an established number of independent archaeological observations.

The stroke classifier is a narrow conditional graphic class. Both W001-W005 and W002-W005 are reported; dotted strokes and W035 are excluded from these two sets. No result-dependent classifier selection is permitted.
A closing-block member is the last token, or the token directly before a terminal W400 or W740. Internal occurrences before a nonterminal W400/W740 do not qualify.

Analytic means and variances refer to independently uniform within-string arrangements preserving length and code multiplicity. They describe ordering under that reference, not probabilities of meanings.
No new permutations are generated. Fisher table comparisons are descriptive after selection, with formula and production dependence unresolved.

The W617 sensitivity replaces every instance with the ordered abstract tokens G617a and G617b. These names do not assert an exact Wells/Mayig crosswalk. Re-deduplication follows recoding. The individual-token analytic reference breaks the grid pair's adjacency; pair-block counts are therefore reported separately.

Retain terminal-only counts and compare closing-block counts, including the W154/W158 descriptive Fisher contrast.
Report initial, medial and final counts, analytic expectations, variances and z scores separately for length-two and length-at-least-three strings.
Check W130/W035 and terminal-W171 claims against the reading-order field; report IDs/CISI and orientation summaries without source strings.

Enumerate exact one-slot substitution templates for all ten targets; publish length distributions, alternative-code counts and conditional alternative classes, without residual templates.
Report W151/W740 shared-template counts and lengths explicitly.
Report exact preceding-pair clusters using opaque IDs, declared class flags and per-category support/closing rates. Do not publish the unbounded list of raw preceding pairs.
Recode W617 as two abstract tokens, re-deduplicate, and report analytic position summaries and pair terminal/closing-block counts.
Emit a per-code catalogue summary joining context, analytic position, formula-cluster and substitution aggregates for the next viewer.
storage: Public outputs contain aggregate counts, opaque formula-cluster identifiers and selected source IDs/CISI. They contain no full inscription strings, residual substitution templates or corpus rows. Reproduction needs the local pinned corpus input.
verification: Assert pinned input hash, declared frame sizes, agreement of pooled counts and expectations with frozen run-v2, conservation of token positions, substitution symmetry and Fisher terminal-table agreement. Hash code, protocol, used inputs and outputs.
